extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the wife in financial remedy proceedings at the Family Court at Leeds enquires about funding estimated costs of £35,500 to FDR, with matrimonial assets of around £282,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and passed to our underwriting team for review. To take this further we would need the date of the next hearing or listed FDR, confirmation of your client's identity and address details, a breakdown of the £35,500 costs estimate, and supporting evidence of the matrimonial assets including the property and pension valuations and any existing charges. It would also help to have confirmation of the current position on disclosure and whether any other funding has been sought. We cannot comment on eligibility or terms at this stage, as all applications are subject to our assessment criteria. A member of the team will be in touch once the file has been reviewed.
